replacements.Calibración de un juez humano o basado e: Calibration of a human or LLM-based judge before using it as a release gate
replacements.El juez también forma parte del sistema: The judge is part of the measurement system too
replacements.La señal útil no es «el LLM dio 4/5». Pr: The useful signal is not 'the LLM gave it 4/5.' First define the construct and rubric, calibrate on a development bank, freeze the judge identity, preserve independent judgments, and only then measure agreement, variance, and bias. The final result is an allowed scope, not universal authority.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable de calibración, acu: Scrollable diagram of judge calibration, agreement, bias, and scope
replacements.Cadena de calibración de un judge antes: Judge calibration chain before a release gate
replacements.El constructo de producto se transforma: The product construct becomes a rubric and calibration bank. The concrete judge version is frozen with model, prompt, configuration, and parser. Validation items are presented blindly and randomly to independent humans and repeated LLM-judge runs. Position swaps, controlled-style probes, and family crosses test for bias. Raw labels feed agreement, confusion matrix, kappa, variance, and swap-consistency diagnostics. Those diagnostics determine whether to accept, restrict, or reject the judge and route unreliable cases to human review.
replacements.1 · DEFINE Y CONGELA QUÉ ESTÁ JUZGANDO: 1 · DEFINE AND FREEZE WHAT IS BEING JUDGED
replacements.si cambia una pieza, vuelve a validar el: if one piece changes, revalidate the judge
replacements.guarda distribución, no sólo media: keep the distribution, not only the mean
replacements.κ si el diseño lo permite: κ when the design supports it
replacements.calibra la rúbrica en desarrollo, congel: calibrate the rubric during development, freeze one concrete judge version, and validate it on an independent bank. Preserve human labels and repeated LLM judgments before adjudication or aggregation. Reverse positions and control style/family to probe bias. Agreement, κ, variance, and swap consistency are different diagnostics; together they define where the judge may automate and where human fallback is required.
